status: stability-corrected after the v1 smoke test became non-finite

training.sampler: deterministic equal round-robin over six de novo and seven editing arity buckets

numerical_safety.v1_failure: non-finite loss, gradient norm, and all trainable adapter values during the 20-step smoke test
numerical_safety.correction: use physical batch 1 for variable-length rows, preserve effective batch 65 with accumulation 65, and reduce learning rate from 8e-5 to 2e-5
numerical_safety.smoke_gate: check every microbatch loss and gradient; release full training only after a clean smoke test
numerical_safety.full_guard: check gradients before every optimizer step and adapter values after every optimizer step

ablations.task_alignment: compare the final fresh adapter before and after the frozen 11520-row task-aligned refresh

evaluation.editing: 500 frozen sources for each of ten tasks
